steps.what: Confer with coworkers and clarify customers' inquiries against account facts
Draft correspondence answering the customer's inquiry

loop.purpose: Draft an answer from verified facts
loop.input: Verified reply brief with source references and permitted explanation
loop.check: Clerk checks factual meaning, qualifications and whether wording implies unauthorized advice or commitments
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported matters return to manual drafting or a qualified colleague
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text customer questions require tailored explanation; fixed answers cover only standard cases

steps.what: Check and send the customer correspondence, clarifying any remaining concerns

tasks.design: Use {CRM} and the securities account system in {OTHER} to establish a verified reply brief. A bounded draft in {EMAIL} helps wording; the clerk retains colleague consultation, customer discussion and sending authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Account facts and explanations had to be assembled before wording each reply.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-bounded draft can reuse facts already verified by the clerk.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed account events and market explanations need context and may require a qualified adviser.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the concern and explain limits without inventing a remedy or advice.
tasks.altitude: Less reply drafting; customer and colleague contact remain intact.

reach.learn: How to hand over the customer's question without losing context

evidence.claim: TOPdesk Robin answers from a maintained knowledge base or prepares a request; this supports answer assistance, not securities advice or access to local brokerage accounts.
The brokerage reply design and savings are an unmeasured local scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is answering inquiries, excluding transaction correction, investment advice and original transaction recording. Those actions retain their own effort and authority.

The clerk produces customer/account ID, question, verified transaction facts, source timestamps, permitted explanation and unresolved issues in s1; capture and colleague clarification occupy all 40 hours. Coworkers provide answers during s1 before its brief closes; customer responses arise during s3 before clarification concludes. Missing facts require manual investigation, never an inferred account-problem resolution flag.
OTHER means the securities account system. Test native approved reply assistance before code; no direct account access or autonomous reply is presumed.
unknowns: Permitted reply scope and adviser escalation rules
Availability of approved account and market information
research_questions: Does draft assistance reduce wording time after financial meaning and advice-boundary checks?

incremental.description: Maintain approved answer material and handle draft failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact recipient, account reference, factual statements, qualifications and reply body sent by the clerk; any alteration voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=40+22.75+25=87.75, gross=12.25, upkeep=5, net=7.25. Range 0-3 allows complex disputes, predominantly live conversations or already templated answers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify transaction source records and capture documentation fields
Document transaction details in the required ledger or certificate record layout
Reconcile and commit the transaction documentation

tasks.design: Configure transaction documentation in {OTHER}, the securities recordkeeping system, from verified transaction fields. The clerk reconciles and commits the record; the design neither executes a trade nor moves securities or funds.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same verified transaction fields were copied into repeated record layouts.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved mappings and document layouts can repeat exact field assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Corrections, reversals and inconsistent settlement references require investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when source records do not describe the same economic event.
tasks.altitude: Less record assembly; reconciliation and posting responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How independent source references support reconciliation

evidence.claim: Fixed securities documentation can be assembled from explicitly mapped, verified transaction fields; the design and savings are E1 rather than a measured brokerage case.

assumptions: Boundary is documentation of already executed transactions, excluding trade authorization, settlement, tax decisions and payment. Existing upstream execution effort remains unchanged.

Transaction operations produce execution evidence before s1. In s1 the clerk captures event ID/version, account, instrument ID, event type, quantity, price, currency, trade/settlement dates, fees and reversal references, verifying each against sources. Its 35 hours include missing-field transcription and clarification. Ambiguous events use manual documentation; no completed-settlement flag is inferred.
OTHER means securities recordkeeping. Test native mappings and record templates before custom code; already automatic ledger writes earn no new labour saving.
unknowns: Available source event identifiers and reversal handling
research_questions: Can generated documentation reproduce reversals and conversions without duplicate records?

incremental.description: Mapping upkeep and failed record investigation

approvals.approved_version: Exact event version, account, instrument, economic fields, reversal links and destination record committed; any changed field requires reapproval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=60, gross=40, upkeep=8, net=32. Range 0-15 allows existing automation, inconsistent source exports and complex corporate events.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: File records and operate office equipment

steps.what: Operate standard office machines and handle original paper records
Verify filing identity and type the required document metadata
File the identified copies in their specified document folders
Check and accept the filed record batch

tasks.design: Configure batch filing in {DOCS} using clerk-verified metadata and destinations. Physical handling, typing metadata and acceptance retain their time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified files still needed repetitive folder placement.
tasks.enabler_now: A configured batch operation can place explicitly identified copies without classifying their contents.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong source identity or access classification can expose confidential records.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguous record identity and preserve original documents when required.
tasks.altitude: Less folder placement if it is currently manual; physical work remains unchanged.

reach.learn: How image completeness and source identity support filing

evidence.claim: Configured document filing can place copies from an explicit manifest without automating physical handling or metadata judgement; the proposed time split is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is general filing and office-machine work. Securities transaction documentation belongs to 20622 and is excluded from this filing saving; roll-ups must assign overlapping records once.

The clerk creates digital copies in s1 and captures file ID, source version, record type, account reference, destination folder, access group and retention instruction in s2. Capture consumes 25 hours; unclear metadata is resolved manually there. No free document-classification or authorized-destination flag exists.
Native batch filing precedes custom code. Automated staging has no final release authority; s4 acceptance binds the batch.
unknowns: Share of current work spent placing digital files
Existing batch filing and retention settings
research_questions: How much folder placement remains after counting physical handling and metadata capture?

already_counted.description: Physical handling and office equipment operation

incremental.description: Filing configuration and failed batch upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact file checksums, manifest, destinations, access groups and accepted batch; changed copies or destinations void acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=80, gross=20, upkeep=5, net=15. Range 0-5 allows mainly physical office work or existing automatic filing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Answer phones, clarify callers' requests and direct calls
Distribute incoming mail to the identified recipients

tasks.design: Keep call clarification in {TELEPHONY} and physical mail distribution with the clerk. Native routing may already help, but this broad task provides no established digital sorting or repeated transfer baseline to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: Unclear recipients and caller intentions require clarification.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes savings for the described human and physical actions.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive correspondence and ambiguous requests need careful handling.
tasks.human_edge: Find the responsible colleague while preserving confidentiality and caller context.
tasks.altitude: Clerical contact and distribution work remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How to resolve ambiguous requests without disclosing account details

evidence.claim: Physical mail distribution and call clarification have no demonstrated reducible automated substep under this task boundary.

assumptions: Boundary is reception and distribution, excluding substantive account answers counted in 8145 and later document filing counted in 8149.

Callers supply requests during s1; senders provide addressed mail before s2. The clerk checks identity, destination and ambiguity within each retained step. The office administrator maintains the existing directory unchanged; no new structured-address capture is transferred to others.
Test native call routing before any custom proposal. Existing routing runtime earns no labour saving. No new service means zero upkeep.
research_questions: Are repeated transfers a material separate burden after request clarification?

already_counted.description: Physical mail distribution and recipient checks

incremental.description: No added system or work transfer

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Neither physical mail handling nor live clarification loses time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated transaction and filing assembly may shrink; reconciliation, customer discussion and physical clerical work retain time and authority.
reach: Learn document capture quality from an office machine operator
Learn call handover practices from a telephone operator
role.ambitious_version: A clerk who produces traceable account documentation and handles customer questions within clearly understood authority.
